name: Halloween
overview: Scripture warns believers to avoid any involvement with occult practices such as witchcraft, divination, and consulting familiar spirits, as seen in Leviticus 19:31, 20:27, and Deuteronomy 18:10. Christians are called to reject the darkness and deception that can be associated with such practices, instead embracing transformation through the renewing of the mind to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). The Bible also instructs believers to train children in godly ways to prevent them from turning away from truth (Proverbs 22:6), and cautions against confusing good and evil or light and darkness (Isaiah 5:20), which is relevant when considering participation in celebrations like Halloween.
